t: Holding a child who is dying
a: إِنَّ الْعَيْنَ تَدْمَعُ، وَالْقَلْبَ يَحْزَنُ، وَلاَ نَقُولُ إِلاَّ مَا يَرْضَى رَبُّنَا، وَإِنَّا بِفِرَاقِكَ يَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ لَمَحْزُونُونَ
p: Inna-l-ʿayna tadmaʿ, wa-l-qalba yaḥzan, wa lā naqūlu illā mā yarḍā rabbunā, wa innā bi-firāqika yā Ibrāhīma la-maḥzūnūn.
m: The eye weeps and the heart grieves, and we say nothing except what pleases our Lord. And we are, at parting from you, Ibrāhīm, deeply grieved.
